name: g15_ef_chain
purpose: Step G15, Expanding Force in Psychic Terrain (Indeedee's Psychic Surge): a grounded user's Expanding Force is a spread move that hits both foes (the 0.75 spread modifier, [spread] on the move line) with its base power x1.5 from the move's own handler after the terrain's x5325/4096; Twisted Spoon (priority 15) in the first part and Helping Hand (10) in the second chain before them (the BasePower order of data/moves.ts:4952-4957 against :14095-14150). Turn 1 leaves Raichu at 8 percent and Rillaboom at 27 and Indeedee faints; Delphox comes in and, with Helping Hand, knocks Rillaboom out and is resisted by Gholdengo.
